Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

weather — the state of the air outside. Example: What is the weather like?
spring — the season after winter. Example: In spring the weather is warm.
summer — the hottest season. Example: In summer it is hot.
sea — the salt water near the coast. Example: The sea is in the south.
mountain — a very high hill. Example: There is a high mountain near the village.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• In my country ...
• The summer is hot.
• There are mountains in the north.
• It is sunny in the south.
• My favourite season is ...

Grammar focus: It is + weather adjective.
Describe the climate of your country: In my country the summer is hot and the winter is cold. Use there is and it is: There are mountains in the north and it is sunny in the south.

elements.content: Complete the sentence.
Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
In my country the summer is hot and the winter is cold. There are mountains in the north and the sea is in the south. In spring it is windy and in autumn it rains.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: What is the climate like in your country? B: Hot in summer, cold in winter. A: Are there mountains? B: Yes, in the north.
